build_d4rl_dataset_generator: build a D4RL dataset generator that reads HDF5 files and yields RLDS-formatted episodes
read_d4rl_dataset_file: read a D4RL HDF5 dataset file and return its contents as a dictionary
generate_d4rl_examples: generate examples from a D4RL dataset file by converting steps and episodes to RLDS format
build_nested_metadata: build a nested metadata dictionary from flattened D4RL dataset keys with prefix paths
build_episode_dict: build a complete episode dictionary from dataset steps with terminal and next observation handling
